notes: Cash (modified cash) basis. Governmental lines from Total Governmental Funds column (p7, after Eliminations column). Transfer to Nutrition Fund 65,000 is printed among disbursements; moved to transfers_out, so printed total disbursements 14,695,890 includes transfers_out (disbursement items sum to 14,630,890). Facilities 450,000 (General) and transfer from other funds 450,000 (Depreciation) are eliminated in the total column (net 0), so omitted from top-level lists; in detail the General Fund Facilities line is recorded as other financing -450,000 and the Depreciation transfer as +450,000. Beginning/ending cash = total governmental fund balances 9,245,903 / 10,306,577 (cash basis). Statement 'Fines and licenses' 79,477 split (attempt 4) using the General Fund schedule p10: 2110 Fines and licenses 77,067 (Fines and Licenses) + 1911 Local license fees 2,410 (licenses and permits). Grants and donations total 75,361 = General 33,361 + Building 42,000. Statement 'Other' 19,708 = General 9,104 (1990 Other 9,084 + 1910 Rental 20) + Depreciation 10,604. Business-type = Nutrition Fund (p9): receipts lines (operating 619,991 + interest 148 = 620,139) exclude 65,000 transfer from General Fund (business_type.transfers_net); disbursements sum 696,666; roll: 36,272 + 620,139 - 696,666 + 65,000 = 24,745. Balance sheet (user 2026-10-27): governmental lines from the governmental funds Balance Sheet (p5, Total Governmental Funds column, fund balance by classification; totals 10,306,577 equal the government-wide governmental figures), plus the business-type cash/net position 24,745 from the government-wide statement (p1); total assets/equity 10,331,322 computed; p1 prints total assets 10,331,321 vs net position 10,331,322 (report rounding, in report_discrepancies). Detail: budgetary comparison schedules for General (p10), Depreciation (p11) and Building (p12) funds (Actual column, final budget), plus combining statement of other governmental funds (p14: Qualified Capital Purpose, Contingency, Activity). No budget schedules for Bond fund or Nutrition fund in trimmed PDF. Read pages 1-14 of 14 (p13, the Combining Balance Sheet of Other Governmental Funds, holds only cash and fund balances already in the p5 Total column; the PDF has no Bond Fund budget schedule).
